tone.target: punchy arena rock crunch with edge-of-breakup grit
tone.profile: punchy arena rock crunch with edge-of-breakup grit
tone.summary: The chain uses a Boost/OD for initial drive and compression, followed by an AC30 TB amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab. Subtle delay and plate reverb add necessary depth without sounding overly processed.
corrections: keep fuzz hint but not heavy fuzz
